transcript.text: Hello, I am an automated assistant from the flood response. Are you safe right now?
I'm okay, but my husband slipped in the kitchen and he can't get up. His leg looks bad.

note: resident fine but household member fell (household medical)

transcript.text: Hello, I am an automated assistant. There is a flash flood warning. Are you safe?
Oh I'm fine, I'm fine. The water is just coming in under the front door, it's only ankle deep in the living room. I'm on the ground floor.

note: says fine while water is entering the ground floor

transcript.text: Hello, I am an automated assistant calling about the flood warning. Are you safe right now?
I don't want to talk to a machine. Can I speak to a real person please?
I understand. A coordinator will follow up. Are you safe at the moment?
I just want a real person.

note: asks for a human; status unclear -> must request human review

transcript.text: 您好，我是社区防洪的自动助理。您现在安全吗？
transcript.text_en: Hello, I am the community flood response's automated assistant. Are you safe now?

transcript.text: 安全，安全。我在五楼，儿子陪着我，家里有吃的也有药。
transcript.text_en: Safe, safe. I am on the fifth floor, my son is with me, we have food and medicine at home.

note: clear safe upper floor with family

transcript.text: 您好，我是自动助理，打来是因为洪水警报。您还好吗？
transcript.text_en: Hello, I am an automated assistant calling about the flood warning. Are you okay?

transcript.text: 我胸口很闷，从早上开始就喘不过气来。
transcript.text_en: My chest feels very tight, I have been short of breath since this morning.

transcript.text: 您好，我是社区防洪的自动助理。听得到吗？您安全吗？
transcript.text_en: Hello, I am the community flood response's automated assistant. Can you hear me? Are you safe?

transcript.text: 喂？
transcript.text_en: Hello?

transcript.text: 您好，听得到我说话吗？
transcript.text_en: Hello, can you hear me?

transcript.text: 喂？喂？
transcript.text_en: Hello? Hello?

note: resident only says hello?, no meaningful answer

transcript.text: Helo, saya pembantu automatik daripada pasukan respons banjir. Adakah anda selamat sekarang?
transcript.text_en: Hello, I am an automated assistant from the flood response team. Are you safe now?

transcript.text: Saya boleh tinggal di rumah, air masih rendah. Tapi saya perlukan bantuan untuk angkat barang dan beras ke tingkat atas.
transcript.text_en: I can stay at home, the water is still low. But I need help carrying my things and rice upstairs.

transcript.text: Helo, saya pembantu automatik. Ada amaran banjir kilat. Adakah anda selamat?
transcript.text_en: Hello, I am an automated assistant. There is a flash flood warning. Are you safe?

transcript.text: Air dah masuk rumah, sampai paras buku lali. Saya tinggal di tingkat bawah dan kaki saya lemah, tak boleh keluar sendiri.
transcript.text_en: Water has entered the house, ankle deep. I live on the ground floor and my legs are weak, I can't get out by myself.

transcript.text: Helo, saya pembantu automatik respons banjir. Adakah anda selamat?
transcript.text_en: Hello, I am the flood response automated assistant. Are you safe?

transcript.text: Oh ya, saya sangat 'selamat'. Air dah paras lutut dalam dapur, tapi tak apa lah, saya selamat.
transcript.text_en: Oh yes, I am very 'safe'. The water is knee deep in the kitchen, but never mind, I am safe.

note: sarcasm / contradiction: says safe while water is knee deep

transcript.text: வணக்கம், நான் வெள்ள உதவி மையத்தின் தானியங்கி உதவியாளர். நீங்கள் இப்போது பாதுகாப்பாக இருக்கிறீர்களா?
transcript.text_en: Hello, I am the flood response centre's automated assistant. Are you safe now?

transcript.text: ஆமாம், நான் நேற்றே என் மகள் வீட்டுக்கு வந்துவிட்டேன். இங்கே தண்ணீர் இல்லை, எல்லாம் நன்றாக இருக்கிறது.
transcript.text_en: Yes, I came to my daughter's house yesterday. There is no water here, everything is fine.

note: safe away from the area at a relative's home

transcript.text: வணக்கம், நான் தானியங்கி உதவியாளர். வெள்ள எச்சரிக்கை பற்றி அழைக்கிறேன். நீங்கள் நலமா?
transcript.text_en: Hello, I am an automated assistant calling about the flood warning. Are you well?

transcript.text: என் இன்சுலின் மருந்து நேற்றோடு தீர்ந்துவிட்டது. கடை மூடியிருக்கிறது, எனக்கு தலை சுற்றுகிறது.
transcript.text_en: My insulin ran out yesterday. The shop is closed and I feel dizzy.

transcript.text: வணக்கம், நான் வெள்ள உதவி மையத்தின் தானியங்கி உதவியாளர். நீங்கள் பாதுகாப்பாக இருக்கிறீர்களா?
transcript.text_en: Hello, I am the flood response centre's automated assistant. Are you safe?

transcript.text: நான் மூன்றாவது மாடியில் இருக்கிறேன், தண்ணீர் மேலே வரவில்லை. ஆனால் உணவும் குடிநீரும் தீர்ந்துவிட்டது.
transcript.text_en: I am on the third floor, the water has not come up. But my food and drinking water have run out.
